name: ACA 121 换盲降 PAPI暗 必须成功复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 121, you are 6 miles from touch down, your fuel warning light is on, call Wuhan Approach for ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 121，距接地点 6 海里，燃油警告灯亮，呼叫 武汉进近请求 ILS 进近和优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA121, our fuel warning light is on, request ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA121，我们的燃油警告灯亮，请求 ILS 进近和优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, Wuhan Approach, roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, you are 5 and half miles from touch down.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，武汉进近，收到，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，右转航向 300 加入五边，你距接地点 5.5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，右转航向 300 加入五边，ACA121。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, contact 118.7 for Tower, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，右转至 310 切入航向道，联系塔台 118.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, 118.7, good day, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转至 310 切入航向道，118.7，再见，ACA121。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Wuhan Tower, you are approaching Alpha Kilo Oscar, level at 1100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系武汉塔台，你正接近 Alpha Kilo Oscar，保持 1100 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121 is approaching AKO, level at 1100m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121 正接近 AKO，保持 1100 米。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, for your information there is lighting maintenance in progress near the end of runway.
B: You ask if ILS category II is available.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，通知你，跑道末端附近正在进行灯光维护。
B: 你询问 ILS II 类是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, ILS category II is available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，ILS II 类可用吗？

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, ILS category II is unserviceable due to the inoperative center line lighting, ILS category I minimum is effective.
B: Read back lighting system information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，由于中线灯不工作，ILS II 类不可用，ILS I 类最低标准有效。
B: 复诵灯光系统信息。
cards.referenceText: ILS category II is unserviceable, ILS category I minimum is effective, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: ILS II 类不可用，ILS I 类最低标准有效，ACA121。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor.
B: Read back the runway conditions.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差。
B: 复诵跑道状况。
cards.referenceText: Runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，ACA121。

cards.audioText: B: You request to dim the approach lights to grade 3, they look 2 bright from your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你请求把进近灯调暗到 3 级，从你的飞机看太亮。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, please dim the approach light to grade 3, they look 2 bright from here.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，请把进近灯调暗到 3 级，从这里看太亮。

cards.audioText: C: Roger. Air Canada 121, check gear down and you are cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到。Air Canada 121，检查起落架放下，可以着陆。

cards.audioText:
B: You have 3 green lights, the PAPI appears to be a little bit low but actually your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.


(PAPI: precision approach path indicator)
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你有 3 个绿灯，PAPI 看起来有点低，但实际上飞机在下滑道上方。向塔台报告。


（PAPI：精密进近航径指示器）
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we have 3 green lights on, the PAPI appears a little bit low but we are high on the glide path.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，我们有 3 个绿灯，PAPI 看起来有点低，但我们在下滑道上方。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, look at the whole airfield and adjust your descent rate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，观察整个机场，调整下降率。
cards.referenceText: Look into a whole airfield and adjust the descent rate, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 观察整个机场，调整下降率，ACA121。

cards.audioText: B: You tell controller you're overshooting, your altitude is too high.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员你复飞了，高度太高。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we are too high, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，我们太高，复飞。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, check your aircraft condition in the holding area, contact Departure on 119.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，在等待区检查飞机状态，联系 Departure 119.9。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, confirm you are overshooting.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，确认你正在复飞。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we are going around, ACA121.

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, sir, what's your intention, please?
B: Tell Departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，先生，请问你的意图？
B: 告诉 Departure 你想盘旋回来在跑道 36R 再次着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA121, we would like to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA121，我们想盘旋回来在跑道 36R 再次着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, I am sorry to inform you that runway 36R is closed, there are patches of snow and much debris on the runway. Use runway 04 instead, fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，很抱歉通知你，跑道 36R 关闭，跑道上有片状积雪和大量碎片。改用跑道 04，飞航向 134 切入跑道 04 航向道。
cards.referenceText: Runway 04, heading 134 to intercept localizer of runway04, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04，航向 134 切入跑道 04 航向道，ACA121。

cards.audioText: C. Air Canada 121, the wind is northwest about 10 to 15, turn left heading 070 and descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1001.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，风为西北风约 10 到 15，左转航向 070，按 QNH 1001 下降到 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 070 and descend to 1200m on QNH 1001, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 070，按 QNH 1001 下降到 1200 米，ACA121。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, what is the status of your aircraft, please?
B: Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but this time you don't have enough fuel for another missed approach, you want a successful landing this time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，请问你的飞机状态？
B: 告诉管制员飞机状态良好，但这次你没有足够燃油再次复飞，希望这次成功着陆。
cards.referenceText: My aircraft is in good condition, but I don't have enough fuel for another missed approach, I must make it this time, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的飞机状态良好，但我没有足够燃油再次复飞，这次必须落地，ACA121。
